sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Stops Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Adjust and MoEngage from collecting usage data.
Fixes sending the verification code when signing in with a phone number.
Lets a new phone number receive the verification code and sign in.
Removes ads and upgrade prompts. Shows the VIP badge in the header.
